_comment: SPARK — S161 P6. The six RACE SEAT BANNERS: the artwork behind a lobby seat tile.
Owner, 2026-09-03: *"the popup menue should have a color with an artistic background that shows
the race and color. so instead of P1 Host (you) its going to be background that has a cool art
that defines the race and color - we'll need to generate it). and it will say P1 HOST (Race name)
without the "(you)" because only your own will be clickable so players will know its them."*
⛔ THESE ARE NOT SPRITES, AND EVERY CONSTRAINT THE CASTLES CARRY IS INVERTED HERE.
A castle still is matted to transparency by build-sprite-atlas.mjs and pasted into a square cell,
which is why those prompts demand a pure white background, forbid near-white anywhere in the
subject, and forbid a ground shadow. A banner is the opposite kind of object: it is FULL-BLEED
art that fills a 380 x 150 seat tile edge to edge, it never touches the atlas builder, and it is
masked to a rounded rectangle at draw time. So: no white background, no matte, no near-white
hazard, and detail is wanted right up to the edges.
⭐ THE CENTRE IS DELIBERATELY THE QUIET PART. `seatRack.ts` centres the seat label over this art
— "P1  HOST  (VAMPIRES)" — so a busy or bright middle would swallow it. Each prompt asks for the
focal detail at the LEFT and RIGHT and a darker, calmer centre band. The renderer also lays a
scrim behind the text, but a scrim heavy enough to rescue a bright centre would hide the art it
is drawn over, so the composition does the work and the scrim only finishes it.
⚠ ASPECT. The tile is 380 x 150 = 2.53:1 and the widest ratio the model offers is 16:9 = 1.78:1,
so the banner is centre-cropped vertically at draw time. Nothing load-bearing may sit in the top
or bottom fifth of the frame — that band does not survive to the screen.
⭐ COLOUR IS THE POINT. A seat tile used to be a flat swatch of PLAYER_COLORS[seat] and nothing
else; that is what the owner is replacing. Each banner is dominated by its race's own seat colour
so the tile still answers "which colour am I?" at a glance, and the art answers "who am I?".
ORIGINAL DESIGNS ONLY, and the same drawing language as the castles and the goblin roster: bold
black ink outline, flat cel shading, crisp highlights. No recognisable franchise imagery.
sharedStyle: Cartoon vector game-art illustration in a bold black ink outline style with flat cel shading and
crisp highlight streaks — the drawing language of a hand-inked tabletop game box.
A WIDE CINEMATIC BANNER that fills the whole frame edge to edge. No white background, no border,
no frame, no margin, no vignette box — the art bleeds off all four sides.
⛔ COMPOSITION: the focal detail sits at the LEFT and RIGHT thirds. The CENTRE THIRD is a calmer,
DARKER, low-detail band — deep shadow, dark sky, dark water or dark stone — because large text is
overlaid there and must stay readable.
⛔ Keep everything important out of the TOP FIFTH and the BOTTOM FIFTH of the frame; those bands
Overall value is MID-TO-DARK so light text reads over it. Rich saturated colour, deep shadows, a
few bright accents — never a pale or washed-out image.
No text, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no UI, and no human faces.

characters.name: banner-vampires
characters.prompt: A gothic vampire stronghold at night. On the left, the silhouette of a tall narrow keep with three pointed spires; on the right, a thorned wrought-iron gate and a swarm of small bats wheeling upward. Between them a dark crimson night sky. COLOUR: dominated by deep crimson and oxblood red — a crimson sky, blood-red clouds, dusty rose rim-light on the stonework, near-black iron and silhouettes, cool violet-plum shadows. The central band is the darkest part of the sky.

characters.name: banner-nagas
characters.prompt: A sunken naga reef fortress underwater. On the left, branching coral columns and great fluted scallop shells; on the right, the coiled body and raised head of a carved stone sea serpent. Shafts of light slanting down through the water between them. COLOUR: dominated by bright aqua-cyan and turquoise — glowing cyan water, pale seafoam highlights on the coral, deep teal and navy shadows, dull sand-grey barnacles as the one non-cyan material. The central band is deep dark teal water.

characters.name: banner-mummies
characters.prompt: A mummy dynasty tomb complex at desert dusk. On the left, the stepped tiers of a sandstone pyramid; on the right, a tall obelisk and a great carved scarab beetle in relief. Drifting sand and a low burning horizon between them. COLOUR: dominated by warm golden yellow and amber — a gold-ochre sky, sunlit amber sandstone, deep umber-brown shadows in every joint, dull bronze for the scarab. The central band is deep shadowed umber.

characters.name: banner-zombies
characters.prompt: A rotting zombie graveyard swamp under sickly fog. On the left, a crooked patchwork shack of warped nailed planks leaning badly; on the right, a palisade of sharpened stakes and long bones with clawed hands breaking the mud. Low green mist between them. COLOUR: dominated by sickly moss green and lichen — a poisonous green fog, pale yellow-green glow low down, deep swamp-green and brown-black shadows, grey-brown rotted timber and dull grey-tan bone. The central band is the darkest, thickest fog.

characters.name: banner-orcs
characters.prompt: An orc war camp at dusk. On the left, a stockade wall of enormous lashed logs banded with crude iron; on the right, a pair of crossed axes mounted on a post beside a burning brazier throwing embers. Smoke and firelight between them. COLOUR: dominated by burnt orange and rust red — an ember-orange sky, hot amber firelight on the wood grain, deep brown and charcoal shadows, blackened iron bands and dark ochre rope. The central band is dark smoke.

characters.name: banner-demons
characters.prompt: A demon citadel of jagged volcanic glass. On the left, a cluster of sharp faceted obsidian shards thrusting upward; on the right, a wide horned archway with heavy chains looped between hanging braziers. A glowing fissure runs across the ground between them. COLOUR: dominated by violet-magenta — hot magenta glow from the fissure and the braziers, bright magenta highlights on the glassy facets, near-black purple shadows, dull dark iron for the chains. The central band is near-black purple glass.
